metadata.description: award-polish: an agent skill for polishing websites, web apps and app interfaces with Awwwards winners as the bar and a calibrated, blind review loop.

plugins.name: award-polish
plugins.description: Polish websites, web apps and app interfaces with Awwwards winners as the bar: improve in batches scored by independent reviewers on one calibrated ruler, with blind side-by-side checks against the best version so far and a layout checker for overflow, covered buttons and clipped elements at five widths.
